description.zh: 边缘应用的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**应用管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标应用名称上获取ID。
description.en: The ID of the edge application. To obtain the ID, go to the **Application Management** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), and move the mouse pointer over the name of the target application.
The version number of the edge application.

description.zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the edge instance. To obtain the ID, go to the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), and move the mouse pointer over the name of the target edge instance.  

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to retrieve the ID.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances. Pass this parameter for Enterprise instances.

title.zh: 绑定边缘应用到边缘实例
title.en: Attach an edge application to an edge instance

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Condition  
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 5 queries per second (QPS) to call this API.  

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
